class CardSet Position information of the display on a diagram of all classes and of their associations

CardSet 1 -- * CardA Card has A CardSet. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one CardSet.A CardSet has some Cards. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.When a Card is created, its CardSet must be assigned. When a Card is deleted, its CardSet is not deleted and its list of Cards is decreased. When a CardSet is deleted, its Cards are not deleted. They are assigned to another CardSet.
